note: Gmail filters apply to incoming mail only. The existing backlog is handled by the cleanup phase, not by these.

filters.description: Payment and receipt senders (stripe.com, squareup.com, intuit.com...) → label IS/Receipts 2026, stay in the inbox

criteria.from: stripe.com OR squareup.com OR intuit.com OR paypal.com OR bill.com OR ramp.com OR brex.com OR expensify.com

filters.description: Machine-only platform notices (vercel.com, cloudflare.com, namecheap.com...) → label Admin and skip the inbox

criteria.from: vercel.com OR cloudflare.com OR namecheap.com OR godaddy.com

filters.description: Collaboration tools where a person triggered the mail (github.com, slack.com, notion.so...) → label Admin, stay in the inbox

criteria.from: github.com OR slack.com OR notion.so OR figma.com OR linear.app OR atlassian.com

filters.description: Newsletters (deeperlearning.producthunt.com, producthunt.com, m.learn.coursera.org...) → label Newsletters and skip the inbox

criteria.from: deeperlearning.producthunt.com OR producthunt.com OR m.learn.coursera.org OR tldrnewsletter.com OR substack.com OR beehiiv.com OR leftclick.ai
